contents.name: Chapter 1 §1.2: integrated covariance and Green–Kubo diffusion formula
contents.support: The source derives the covariance identity for an integrated stationary process and identifies the Green–Kubo form under its stated assumptions. The local OU proof supplies the exact forward-time covariance calculation and does not import a central limit theorem.

contents.name: Chapter 4 §§4.2 and 4.4: OU transition law, thermal parameter and stationary covariance

contents.name: Nonlinear diffusion and homogenization applications beyond the scalar OU case
